description: This Kotlin source file contains utility functions related to diagnostics and status reporting for the OpenClaw Android application. It includes functions to generate diagnostic reports, interpret gateway status, and copy reports to the clipboard, primarily used for debugging network and gateway connection issues.

methods.name: openClawAndroidVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns the application version label, appending '-dev' if in debug mode and the version name is not already marked as a development build.

methods.name: gatewayStatusForDisplay
methods.description: Normalizes gateway status text for display, defaulting to 'Offline' if the input is empty.

methods.name: gatewayStatusHasDiagnostics
methods.description: Determines if the gateway status indicates presence of diagnostics (not offline or connecting).

methods.name: gatewayStatusLooksLikePairing
methods.description: Checks if the gateway status suggests pairing or approval based on keywords.

methods.name: buildGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Builds a detailed diagnostic report string containing device, Android version, gateway address, status, and instructions for troubleshooting.

methods.name: copyGatewayDiagnosticsReport
methods.description: Copies the generated diagnostic report to the clipboard and shows a toast notification.
